name: PoV Verifier
description: Independently runs PoV scripts in sandbox and verifies sink location and CWE mechanism.

skills.name: Verify Dual Alignment
skills.description: Re-run PoV script directly in sandbox and check location match plus CWE mechanism match.
examples: Execute script_001.py and confirm target sink crash or security oracle

skills.name: Diagnose PoV Defects
skills.description: Separate script or environment errors from safe code and emit retry suggestions.
examples: Report missing runtime dependency or wrong argument back to PoV Generator

skills.name: Report Final Verdict
skills.description: Emit final CONFIRMED or UNCONFIRMED verdict with runtime proof.
examples: Return CONFIRMED verdict with reproducible runtime evidence
